page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-4-lssd is an arm64-based virtual machine instance featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced resource allocation of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU core. The instance is equipped with a single local NVMe SSD offering 403 GB of high-speed local storage capacity.

The arm64 CPU architecture delivers energy-efficient processing capabilities with dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent performance without resource sharing. The integrated 403 GB NVMe SSD provides low-latency, high-throughput local storage directly attached to the instance, which is beneficial for applications requiring fast read and write cycles. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

Given its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and fast local storage, this instance is suitable for general-purpose workloads, web serving, containerized applications, and small-scale database deployments. The arm64 architecture offers a cost-efficient hardware profile, delivering a favorable balance of processing power and memory density for resource-conscious deployments that do not require GPU acceleration.
